npcs.name: Edda
npcs.greeting: Welcome to Ravenwood. Keep the middle of the steps clear; someone is always hauling something through here.

topics.label: Finding your way
topics.text: The left lane leads to the market. The camp is to the right. Through the gate and up the steps, you will find the upper town and the great hall.

topics.label: The watch
topics.text: We take turns at the gate and the lookout. A quiet shift is a good shift, whatever the others tell you.

npcs.name: Ivo
npcs.greeting: Mind the baskets. I finally arranged them so I can find things without moving the entire stall.

topics.label: Around the square
topics.text: The Green Hart is across the square. Follow the hammering for the smithy; the provisioner keeps the smaller traveling supplies.

topics.label: Market life
topics.text: Everyone stops at the well sooner or later. If you need to find somebody in Ravenwood, patience is often quicker than running.

npcs.name: Orrin
npcs.greeting: If you borrowed a blanket, bring back a blanket. That rule is harder to enforce than you might think.

topics.label: The camp
topics.text: The command tent is beyond the main path. The barracks are on the right, and the training yard is beside them.

topics.label: Supplies
topics.text: Boot leather, clean water, spare cord. None of it looks heroic until you are a long way from home.

npcs.name: Elin
npcs.greeting: You made it up the steps. I always think the view is worth the climb.

topics.label: Upper town
topics.text: The great hall is along the right-hand path. The lookout is to the left. The narrow road ahead winds out toward the woodland.

topics.label: Ravenwood
topics.text: The town grew around these old paths. Every family has a different story about which building was here first.

npcs.name: Mara
npcs.greeting: Come in out of the draft. Even the door sounds tired after a long day.

topics.label: The Green Hart
topics.text: Carters, watchmen, travelers: the tables change, but somebody always wants the chair nearest the fire.

topics.label: A local tip
topics.text: If you are heading beyond the town, speak to the scout near the woodland road. A warm meal is better after a sensible journey.

npcs.name: Bram
npcs.greeting: Stand clear of the coals. A forge does not care whether your boots are new.

topics.label: Your craft
topics.text: A good edge starts long before the final sharpening. The fit, the balance, the temper: rush one and the others cannot save it.

topics.label: Traveling gear
topics.text: Check straps and buckles before you leave town. Most broken equipment gave its owner a warning first.

npcs.name: Nessa
npcs.greeting: Take your time. It is easier to remember what you need while you are still in town.

topics.label: Packing well
topics.text: Put the things you reach for most where you can find them in the dark. Rain does not wait while you unpack a bag.

topics.label: The neighbors
topics.text: Bram handles the heavy work at the forge. Mara at the inn hears who has come through town lately.

npcs.name: Sella
npcs.greeting: Welcome to the great hall. Please leave the aisle clear when the council gathers.

topics.label: The hall
topics.text: People come here with petitions, disputes, and news from the outlying farms. Listening takes more time than the speeches.

topics.label: Looking for someone
topics.text: For the watch, ask at the camp or the lookout. For a place to catch your breath, the Green Hart is down by the market.

npcs.name: Rook
npcs.greeting: Come closer. I would rather hear a clear question than have someone guess at an order.

topics.label: Watch duties
topics.text: Gate duty, lookout duty, patrols. Keeping people safe is usually a matter of noticing small things before they become large ones.

topics.label: Beyond the town
topics.text: Speak with the scout on the woodland approach before following the road. Conditions on a path matter more than how familiar it looks on a map.

npcs.name: Hale
npcs.greeting: Keep your kit together. The floor is not a storage chest.

topics.label: The barracks
topics.text: Rest, mend, clean, repeat. People remember the training yard, but half a soldier’s work happens in a room like this.

topics.label: First advice
topics.text: Find your footing before worrying about speed. A steady stance will do more for you than a dramatic swing.

npcs.name: Tamsin
npcs.greeting: Give your eyes a moment. The farther ridges are easier to pick out once you stop staring at the nearest roof.

topics.label: The valley
topics.text: Watch the roads and the gaps between the trees. Movement is often easier to notice than the thing that is moving.

topics.label: The signal bell
topics.text: A signal is only useful when everyone knows what it means. On a quiet day we practice, even if the whole town complains.

npcs.name: Tessa
npcs.greeting: Slow down at the stream. Wet stone is a poor place to discover that your boots have smooth soles.

topics.label: The woodland road
topics.text: The path narrows beyond the crossing. Listen before you round a bend, and keep enough daylight for the return.

topics.label: Scouting
topics.text: A bent stem can tell you somebody passed. It takes a little more care to work out who, how recently, and whether it matters.
